title: Mutations
description: Learn how to create, update, and delete data with useMutation.
longDescription: This module covers React Query's mutation system. You will learn useMutation for creating, updating, and deleting server data. You will implement optimistic updates for instant UI feedback, use cache invalidation to keep data fresh after writes, and chain mutations with proper error handling and rollback strategies.
whatYouLearn: Handle mutation states: isPending, isSuccess, isError
Implement optimistic updates with onMutate and rollback
Invalidate and refetch queries after mutations
Reset mutation state with reset() for reusable forms
